recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: search tools buckling under impossibly large queries
a new astro loop tracing headlines today
august fog holding san francisco at thirteen degrees
summer heat waiting behind the marine layer

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Pilot a one-thumb buoy through Karl the Fog — hold to rise toward pockets of warmth, release to sink before the marine layer swallows you.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each dive finds one more sunlit gap before the fog closes
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens, warmth orbs shrink and drift faster
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted watercolor fog gradients over gray bay water

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Flick a satellite into decaying orbital loops — each swipe adds velocity but tightens the path; survive sixty seconds without crashing into the planet below.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: chaining perfect orbit loops feels like a slingshot puzzle resolving
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: gravity wells multiply and loop decay accelerates
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe orbital trails on deep space black

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Sort corrupted log lines into match and no-match lanes before a ripgrep scan completes — drag each line left or right as regex patterns grow stranger.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: clearing a batch right as the search bar hits one hundred percent
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: patterns get weirder, lines flood in faster, timer shrinks
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: terminal green on black with glitch artifacts at the edges

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Deploy parallel agent bots from your phone onto a tiny codebase grid — tap nodes to spin up threads that race to patch bugs before their edits collide.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: orchestrating three agents into one clean merge in under a minute
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more agents spawn, conflict windows tighten, grid shrinks
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout tiles with hand-drawn connection lines
